video.title: AI欧腐《被学霸室友撞进心里/Tackled by My Nerd Roommate》
video.desc:
Felix, the captain of the rugby team, has a one-night stand with Jasper, only to discover that he is actually his roommate — and the academic tutor who helps him with his studies. As they spend more time together, the two gradually let go of their arrogance and prejudice, overcoming social barriers and eventually finding their way into a relationship.
橄榄球队队长Felix与Jasper有了一夜情，却意外发现，对方竟然就是自己的室友——也是那个帮他补习功课的学业导师。
随着两人相处的时间越来越多，他们逐渐放下各自的傲慢与偏见，跨越身份与圈层的差异，最终一步步走进彼此的心里，发展出一段真正的恋情。
